'''Bull "The Unbreakable" ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Bull was hired by [[Jundo Martik]] to recover stolen ore and drive off the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] pirate gang from a [[Twin Suns mining compound|mine]] in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When Bull and his associates failed to return after a few days, a group of Republic spacers was sent by Jundo Martik to reclaim the mine. Bull and the other mercenaries attempted to frame the spacers for the theft of the ore, but were killed by the droid [[ST-97]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bull "The Unbreakable" appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Reap the Whirlwind" on Tatooine.
